ACME Utility Corp Announces Second-Quarter 2026 Results

EX99_BODY_TOKEN_ETA. RICHMOND, Va. — ACME Utility Corp (NYSE: ACME) today announced financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Revenue grew, driven by data-center & industrial load growth across its service territory.

"We continue to see unprecedented demand," said the Company's Chief Executive Officer.
